bio: Housed in the basement of The H'All Tailor Suite, this restaurant boasts two contemporary-style dining rooms, with tables outside in fine weather. Here, Riccardo Di Giacinto serves regional and Italian specialities which he reinterprets with skill and flair, playing with traditional recipes and transforming these with surprising results. Including dishes such as a “summary” of carbonara, cappelletti in “dry broth”, Roman-style lamb, and tiramisù in both savoury (with potatoes and salted cod) and sweet versions, the cuisine here is both astonishing and satisfying....
